rules.title: Tenants Rights and Resources Notification Ordinance, Chapter 8.71
rules.requirement: Landlords must provide tenants with a guide about tenants' rights and resources at the start of tenancy and when tenancy is being terminated, including when legal steps to terminate tenancy are taken.
rules.summary_plain: Your landlord must give you a guide about your rights and resources when you start your lease and if they begin eviction proceedings.
rules.summary_plain_es: Su arrendador debe proporcionarle una guía sobre sus derechos y recursos al comenzar su contrato y si inician procedimientos de desalojo.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all residential rental agreements including single residential dwelling units in Cambridge, MA.
rules.exemptions_text: Does not apply to rental units in hospitals, skilled nursing or health facilities, non-profit short-term treatment facilities for substance abuse, or Short Term Rental Units as defined in Cambridge Zoning Ordinance Article 4, Section 4.60.
rules.penalty: Fines of $300 for each day of violation.
rules.quoted_span: The Ordinance requires owners, landlords, and management companies to provide you with information at the start of your lease or tenancy as well as when your tenancy is being terminated.
